subject.title: refactor(sessions): replace ambient watch sentinels with provenance

question: Should OpenClaw accept a shared state schema-v4 upgrade that makes older builds refuse databases upgraded by the session-watch provenance migration?
rationale: This is an intentional persisted-state compatibility boundary, so repository policy requires an owner decision in addition to code and test review.

options.title: Accept v4 with upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the canonical provenance design, require a visible legacy-database upgrade demonstration, and document the intentional downgrade refusal.

options.title: Defer the schema bump
options.body: Keep sentinel encoding temporarily and pursue a later migration only after maintainers choose the persistent-state compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Accept v4 with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the canonical provenance design, require a visible legacy-database upgrade demonstration, and document the intentional downgrade refusal.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the related group-watch behavior and authored the proposed schema migration.
